title: Plan: cache order totals and bill from a nightly job
intent: The plan caches each order's total in redis on create and adds a new reports process whose nightly job charges yesterday's orders. The cache is new work; the nightly charge collides with billing that already runs on the bus.

findings.title: Nightly charge duplicates the existing bus consumer
findings.detail: apps/api/src/features/billing/infrastructure/messaging/order-created.consumer.ts already charges every order the moment orders.created arrives. A nightly job that charges yesterday's orders would invoice each order twice. Either drop the job or retire the consumer — the plan keeps both.

findings.title: reports is a new process
findings.detail: No apps/reports and no reports service in infra/compose.yaml. It needs a Dockerfile, a compose entry, and a scheduler — none exist yet.

findings.title: First code to use redis
findings.detail: redis is already in infra/compose.yaml but nothing reads it. The cache write is the first client; a Redis URL must reach the api container.

hops.label: INSERT orders, order_lines, outbox
hops.work: Writes the order, its lines, and an orders.created outbox row in one transaction. Unchanged by the plan.

hops.label: cache adapter (planned)
hops.work: The plan has the use case call a new cache adapter after the save. The use case today saves and returns; there is no such call.

hops.label: SET order:{id}:total (planned)
hops.work: Stores the order total under the order id. redis exists in compose; the adapter and its client do not exist yet.

hops.label: nightly SELECT yesterday's orders (planned)
hops.work: A new process wakes nightly and reads yesterday's orders. No scheduler, process, or compose entry exists for it.

hops.label: POST /charges for each order (planned)
hops.work: The plan has the job ask billing to charge each order. Billing already charges every order from the bus the moment it is created, so this charges twice.
hops.not: Not an alternative to the consumer — the plan does not remove the consumer, it adds a second path to the same invoice table.
